mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, reducing meloxicam plasma concentrations; meloxicam increases renal sodium reabsorption which may reduce eslicarbazepine efficacy through pharmacodynamic mechanisms.
action: Monitor meloxicam efficacy and eslicarbazepine seizure control; consider meloxicam dose adjustment or alternative NSAID; ensure adequate hydration and monitor renal function periodically.
